generation.scope: Every ordinary positive fixed rank-fifteen window on y=lambda*x^3 is standard Koszul and two-sided AS-regular and is free of rank 256 per start over four central quartics when lambda lies in a number field with a place above three of residue degree at most two. This holds for the full eight residual tubes, at every geometric horizontal coordinate. The indexed invariant curve of this pencil has genus two except at lambda=1/27; the shift quotient has genus one and the reduced exceptional curve is rational with exactly two period-one classes.

open_mathematics: Use Pauli translations on odd-length character spaces to move the good ninth character of the fixed four-center cut to all four characters. Intersect the four open subsets of the character-zero center Grassmannian and certify exceptional signed fibers, then apply the remaining high-degree tests. General non-Ore windows and the full AS locus remain open.
